cues.en: Instructor: The purpose of this video is to show you how to implement and evaluate cdfs and their corresponding pdfs in code.
cues.zh: 講師：這部影片的目標，是示範如何用程式實作並求出 CDF，以及對應 PDF 的數值。

cues.en: Let's begin with Matlab, and I'm going to start with a log-normal distribution.
cues.zh: 先從 MATLAB 開始，使用對數常態分布。

cues.en: Now, there's no particular special reason why I'm using a log-normal distribution.
cues.zh: 選擇對數常態分布沒有什麼特別原因。

cues.en: I think it just happens to look nice.
cues.zh: 只是剛好覺得它很好看。

cues.en: Okay, so you can see, let's see.
cues.zh: 好，可以看到，看看。

cues.en: So here is the x axis variable that we are going to evaluate these functions on.
cues.zh: 這裡是要用來求這些函數值的 X 軸變數。

cues.en: So this is like the grid locations that we will use to evaluate the probabilities.
cues.zh: 相當於評估機率時使用的網格位置。

cues.en: Okay, so that's X, and here I just want you to notice the function call pattern.
cues.zh: 這是 X，這裡希望你注意函式呼叫的命名模式。

cues.en: So it's log normal-distribution, and then we have pdf, and cdf.
cues.zh: 前面是對數常態分布，後面則有 pdf 和 cdf。

cues.en: So you can see these two functions are corresponding and the names of the functions are basically the same.
cues.zh: 可以看到，這兩個函式相對應，名稱基本相同。

cues.en: It's pdf, and cdf. Okay?
cues.zh: 差在 pdf 和 cdf，好嗎？

cues.en: So here we are providing three inputs and well, this first input is pretty obvious.
cues.zh: 這裡提供三個輸入，第一個很明顯。

cues.en: This is the values that we are evaluating the probabilities on.
cues.zh: 就是要評估機率的那些數值。

cues.en: And what are these two inputs here?
cues.zh: 那這兩個輸入是什麼？

cues.en: What is zero and what is one?
cues.zh: 0 和 1 是什麼？

cues.en: What do these two numbers correspond to?
cues.zh: 這兩個數字對應什麼？

cues.en: Well, of course, you know, you can try to memorize every Matlab function and all the inputs and all the orders, but that's generally not a good strategy.
cues.zh: 當然可以試著背下每個 MATLAB 函式、所有輸入和順序，但通常不是好策略。

cues.en: So instead what we are going to do is look up the help file.
cues.zh: 所以改成查閱說明檔案。

cues.en: I know I've mentioned this before, but it's a nice reminder.
cues.zh: 我知道以前提過，但值得提醒。

cues.en: You can, let's see you can right click and say help on this function, and it's gonna open up a little help window like this with some documentation.
cues.zh: 可以按右鍵，選擇查看此函式的說明，就會開啟這個小視窗，顯示文件。

cues.en: And this is also nice because it shows you some examples.
cues.zh: 也很好，因為還會展示一些例子。

cues.en: And let's see. So here we can see that it's mu and sigma.
cues.zh: 這裡可以看到，是 μ 和 σ。

cues.en: So this is the central tendency.
cues.zh: 這是集中趨勢。

cues.en: So the average value and the standard deviation value.
cues.zh: 也就是平均值和標準差。

cues.en: And because this is a log normal-distribution, these are actually in log units and not in regular units.
cues.zh: 因為是對數常態分布，所以實際使用對數單位，而不是一般單位。

cues.en: Okay, so then, yeah, the other way you can do this is by opening up the actual function to, and then having a look through the actual code.
cues.zh: 另一種做法，是開啟實際函式，查看程式碼。

cues.en: This is kind of nice, you know, I often like opening up the function.
cues.zh: 這也不錯，我經常喜歡開啟函式。

cues.en: First of all, I find this to be a clean way of looking at the help information, but also you can actually look down through the code.
cues.zh: 首先，我覺得這樣看說明資訊很清楚，此外還能往下查看程式。

cues.en: So you can see that right here.
cues.zh: 就在這裡。

cues.en: This is the actual code that generates a log normal-distribution.
cues.zh: 這是真正產生對數常態分布的程式。

cues.en: In fact, if you look through this code, this should look familiar because we have talked about this function earlier in the course.
cues.zh: 其實看這段程式應該會眼熟，因為課程前面談過這個函數。

cues.en: Okay? Anyway, let's see.
cues.zh: 總之，看看。

cues.en: So here I'm calling this function twice and this is just with different parameters.
cues.zh: 這裡呼叫同一函式兩次，只是參數不同。

cues.en: So just, you know, to make things look a little bit interesting.
cues.zh: 只是為了讓圖形有趣一點。

cues.en: Okay, so here we see the pdfs and their corresponding cdfs.
cues.zh: 這裡可以看到 PDF 及其對應的 CDF。

cues.en: Of course these lines, the shapes of these lines will look familiar from the previous video.
cues.zh: 這些線條的形狀，當然會讓你想起前一部影片。

cues.en: This is the exact same two functions that I used in the previous video in the slides.
cues.zh: 就是前一部影片投影片中使用的同樣兩個函數。

cues.en: Now, I claimed several times in the previous video that the cdf can be obtained simply by computing the cumulative sum of the pdf.
cues.zh: 前一部影片說過好幾次，只要對 PDF 取累積總和，就能得到 CDF。

cues.en: Now, if that's true, then we should be able to compute this manually, so to speak.
cues.zh: 如果這是真的，應該就能手動計算。

cues.en: Instead of calling the log and cdf function, we just call the pdf function.
cues.zh: 不呼叫 logncdf 函式，而是只呼叫 PDF 函式。

cues.en: And then we take the cumulative sum of all of those pdf values.
cues.zh: 然後對所有 PDF 值取累積總和。

cues.en: So we should see that C one X is the same thing as C one.
cues.zh: 所以應該看到 C1x 和 C1 相同。

cues.en: So let's see what happens.
cues.zh: 看看結果。

cues.en: And oh, these two lines definitely do not overlap.
cues.zh: 喔，這兩條線顯然沒有重疊。

cues.en: What is the problem here?
cues.zh: 問題在哪裡？

cues.en: Is Matlab wrong or was I lying to you?
cues.zh: 是 MATLAB 錯了，還是我在騙你？

cues.en: I do make mistakes now and then, but what's actually going on is, first of all, this blue line is not exactly zero, it's just very small.
cues.zh: 我偶爾確實會犯錯，但實際上，首先這條藍線不是恰好為 0，只是非常小。

cues.en: You can see the red dash line here.
cues.zh: 這裡可以看到紅色虛線。

cues.en: This is our like manual cdf here.
cues.zh: 這是我們「手動」計算的 CDF。

cues.en: And that goes up to a value of, you know, 180 or a bit over 180, whatever that value ends up being.
cues.zh: 它會上升到 180 左右，或超過 180 一點，不管最後是多少。

cues.en: So that seems inconsistent. Something seems wrong.
cues.zh: 這似乎不一致，感覺有問題。

cues.en: This blue line here actually corresponds to this line here.
cues.zh: 這條藍線其實對應這裡這條線。

cues.en: So this goes up to one. What is the issue here?
cues.zh: 它會升到 1。問題是什麼？

cues.en: Well this is something that I've discussed several times before in the course.
cues.zh: 這是課程中已經討論過好幾次的事。

cues.en: And basically what we need to do is modify this equation so that we, or this code, so that we are scaling by dx.
cues.zh: 基本上，必須修改這個方程式，或這段程式，讓它乘上 dx 縮放。

cues.en: So we need to scale by the discretization of the x axis values, the grid that we are evaluating the probabilities on.
cues.zh: 必須按照 X 軸數值的離散間距，也就是評估機率所使用的網格，來縮放。

cues.en: So there's several ways to do that.
cues.zh: 有幾種做法。

cues.en: I'm gonna say times X two minus X one.
cues.zh: 我會乘以 X 的第二個值減去第一個值。

cues.en: So this is just the discretization of X.
cues.zh: 這就是 X 的離散間距。

cues.en: And because we define X purely based on linearly spaced numbers.
cues.zh: 而且我們完全用等距數字來定義 X。

cues.en: So because X is linearly spaced, every two successive data points in X has exactly the same distance.
cues.zh: 因為 X 等距，所以每兩個相鄰資料點之間的距離完全相同。

cues.en: Okay? So again, we're just multiplying this probability distribution by dx.
cues.zh: 再次說明，只是把這個機率分布乘以 dx。

cues.en: And then let's try running this code again.
cues.zh: 再執行一次。

cues.en: Ah, and now this looks much better.
cues.zh: 啊，現在好多了。

cues.en: Now you see these two lines are perfectly overlapping, the blue line and the orange or reddish dash line, I hope you can see this on your video screen.
cues.zh: 現在可以看到，藍線和橘色或偏紅的虛線完全重疊，希望你在影片畫面上看得見。

cues.en: If not, you can certainly see this on your Matlab computer.
cues.zh: 如果看不見，在自己的 MATLAB 電腦上一定看得見。

cues.en: So what we are going to do here is evaluate the pdf and the cdf of a function with couple of different input options.
cues.zh: 接下來會用幾組不同輸入選項，求出函數的 PDF 和 CDF。

cues.en: And then we are going to compare that to computing the cdf manually.
cues.zh: 再和手動計算 CDF 的結果比較。

cues.en: Okay, so here we have a variable X that I'm creating.
cues.zh: 這裡先建立變數 X。

cues.en: It's linearly spaced numbers between zero and five, 1000 of them.
cues.zh: 是介於 0 和 5 的 1000 個等距數字。

cues.en: And this is just the variable that we use, like the grid spacing that we use to evaluate the probability functions.
cues.zh: 這就是評估機率函數使用的變數，或者說網格位置。

cues.en: But here I'm using linearly spaced numbers.
cues.zh: 這裡使用等距數字。

cues.en: This is important for what I will get to in a few moments.
cues.zh: 這點對等一下要談的內容很重要。

cues.en: Okay so here we are creating the pdf and cdf from log normal-distributions.
cues.zh: 現在從對數常態分布建立 PDF 和 CDF。

cues.en: You know, there's nothing particularly wildly special about log normal-distributions.
cues.zh: 對數常態分布沒有什麼特別驚人的地方。

cues.en: I just happen to like how they look.
cues.zh: 只是剛好喜歡它的外觀。

cues.en: So that's why I picked this function as an example.
cues.zh: 所以選它作為函數範例。

cues.en: But of course this principle holds for any other probability distribution.
cues.zh: 這個原理當然也適用於任何其他機率分布。

cues.en: Okay? I would like you to note the function call pattern, the logic of the function name.
cues.zh: 請注意函式呼叫模式，以及名稱的邏輯。

cues.en: So we have log norm or the name of the distribution and then dot pdf and dot cdf.
cues.zh: 前面是 lognorm，也就是分布名稱，後面是 .pdf 或 .cdf。

cues.en: Obviously this computes the probability and the cumulative distribution.
cues.zh: 顯然，分別計算機率和累積分布。

cues.en: Here I am inputting this X axis value here.
cues.zh: 這裡輸入 X 軸值。

cues.en: So the values on which to compute the probabilities.
cues.zh: 也就是要在哪些值上計算機率。

cues.en: And the only difference between this pair of lines and this pair of lines is the second input, which is the distribution or the scaling of the probability.
cues.zh: 這兩行和另外兩行唯一差別，在第二個輸入，也就是分布或機率的縮放。

cues.en: You'll see the effect of this second input in a moment.
cues.zh: 等一下會看到第二個輸入的效果。

cues.en: Okay? So let's run that code.
cues.zh: 好，執行程式。

cues.en: Here I'm just drawing the pdfs and the cdfs and in fact, this should look familiar.
cues.zh: 這裡只是畫出 PDF 和 CDF，其實應該很眼熟。

cues.en: These should look familiar. These are exactly the same functions with the same parameters that I used in the video, in the previous video in the slides, different colors and so on.
cues.zh: 它們是前一部影片投影片中，完全相同函數、相同參數，只是顏色等等不同。

cues.en: But yeah, the same probability functions with the same parameters.
cues.zh: 對，是相同參數的相同機率函數。

cues.en: Okay? Now, I claimed several times in the previous video that the cdf is simply the cumulative sum of all the values to the left of each point.
cues.zh: 前一部影片說過好幾次，CDF 就是每個點左側所有值的累積總和。

cues.en: So the value here in this green line at one corresponds to the sum of all of these probability values.
cues.zh: 所以綠線在 1 的值，對應這些機率值的總和。

cues.en: So if that's true, if my claim was correct, then we should be able to like manually, quote on quote, manually compute the cdf or create the cdf
cues.zh: 如果我的說法正確，應該能「手動」計算或建立 CDF，

cues.en: simply by taking the cumulative sum of the probabilities.
cues.zh: 只要對機率取累積總和。

cues.en: And that's what we are doing here.
cues.zh: 這裡做的就是這件事。

cues.en: So I call this variable C one X, it's the cumulative sum of the probability values, and then I'm plotting that on top of C one.
cues.zh: 我將這個變數稱為 C1x，是機率值的累積總和，再疊加畫到 C1 上。

cues.en: Now we certainly expect that these two lines should be identical, they should be overlapping, but oh, something doesn't quite look right.
cues.zh: 我們當然預期兩條線應該相同、重疊，但看起來有點不對。

cues.en: What is going on here?
cues.zh: 怎麼回事？

cues.en: Well, first of all, notice that the blue line C one, it looks like it's flat at zero, but in fact you know that it's not actually flat.
cues.zh: 首先注意，藍線 C1 看起來平貼在 0，但你知道它其實不是平的。

cues.en: It, it goes up to, to a value of one.
cues.zh: 它會上升到 1。

cues.en: But here, you know, look at this our manual computation here and the dash line that goes up to like 180 or something.
cues.zh: 但這裡手動計算的虛線，卻上升到大約 180。

cues.en: Now this completely violates one of the definitions of a cdf that I gave in the previous video that they asymptote to one, they should equal one.
cues.zh: 這完全違反前一部影片給的 CDF 定義之一：它們會漸近於 1，最後應該等於 1。

cues.en: You know, they approach one as you get further out on the x axis over here.
cues.zh: 隨著沿 X 軸往更遠處走，就會趨近於 1。

cues.en: So what is going on here?
cues.zh: 那到底發生什麼事？

cues.en: If you like, you can pause the video and see if you can figure out what the problem is and how to fix it.
cues.zh: 如果願意，可以暫停影片，想想問題和修正方式。

cues.en: So the problem is, like what I've mentioned several times before in this course, in particular in this section with probabilities, we need to scale this probability
cues.zh: 問題就是這門課之前說過好幾次的，尤其在機率這一章：必須依照

cues.en: by the discretization of the X axis.
cues.zh: X 軸的離散間距，縮放這個機率。

cues.en: So we need to basically multiply by dx.
cues.zh: 基本上就是乘以 dx。

cues.en: So something like this.
cues.zh: 像這樣。

cues.en: Now we haven't actually computed an explicit variable df, but what df ends up being is the discretization of the x axis,
cues.zh: 目前還沒有明確計算一個變數 df，但 df 最後就是 X 軸的離散間距，

cues.en: and that is X one minus X zero.
So this is just the distance between any successive pair of X axis values.
cues.zh: 這是任何相鄰一對 X 軸值之間的距離。

cues.en: And this right here is why it's important, why it's relevant that I used linearly spacing to create this X axis value.
cues.zh: 這也就是為什麼用等距數字建立 X 軸很重要、很有關係。

cues.en: So the distance between any two successive X axis points is exactly the same regardless of where you are on the x axis.
cues.zh: 所以，不管位於 X 軸哪裡，任何兩個相鄰 X 軸點之間的距離都完全相同。

cues.en: So that's why we can just take the difference between the second point and the first point.
cues.zh: 因此，只要取第二個點減去第一個點即可。

cues.en: Okay, let's try this again.
cues.zh: 好，再試一次。

cues.en: And woof breathe a sigh of relief here.
cues.zh: 呼，可以鬆一口氣。

cues.en: This looks much better.
cues.zh: 這樣好多了。

cues.en: I hope you can see on the screen that the blue line and the orange dash line overlap and certainly you'll be able to see it on your own screen
cues.zh: 希望你在畫面上看得出藍線和橘色虛線重疊；在自己的電腦螢幕上一定能看出來，

cues.en: in Python, you can zoom in and so on.
cues.zh: 在 Python 中也可以放大等等。
